welcomeCopy: Open format; all people are welcome; no pressure to speak; welcoming newcomers and anyone looking to make Bottom Line their home group.
traditionsNote: Upholds Traditions Six, Seven, Ten, Eleven, and Twelve (attraction rather than promotion, clear separation from outside commercial enterprises, and anonymity protection across public pages, flyers, and forms).

meetings.notes: Drive docs describe this as a sample (Club 101, Tuesdays 7:30 p.m., hybrid). Schedule, timezone, and hybrid/Zoom details remain [VERIFY] until confirmed.

firstMeeting.title: First Meeting? What to Expect
firstMeeting.summary: The only requirement is a desire to stop using. There are no dues or fees, and newcomers do not have to speak or have everything figured out on day one.

regionalNewsAndFlyers.title: Regional Council News, Flyers & Updates
regionalNewsAndFlyers.summary: Displays current regional council announcements and event flyers with a full-page/lightbox viewer, direct download, and print-ready layout.

groupStrugglesForm.title: Group Struggles & Website Feedback
groupStrugglesForm.summary: Connects group leaders and members to the regional feedback channel for meeting support, flyer/print hurdles, and website improvements.
